integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Japanese 2D anime in crisp cel-shaded style, hand-drawn ink outlines, sakuga-quality animation with speed lines and impact frames, warm gold and deep crimson palette over cool blue shadows. A tracking shot frames the transfer student with messy black hair and a jacket scorched at the right shoulder (S1) and the top disciple with loose waist-length black hair and a white-and-gold academy uniform (S2) walking side by side toward the academy gate as the Five Elements Manuscript, an ancient scroll case carved with glowing jade-green characters, rests safely on its pedestal behind them, its glow settling. The camera trucks right at slow speed with strong parallax past the kneeling students. [Shot 2] At 00:02.600, the camera cuts to an extreme wide of the two figures stepping through the gate into the gold morning sky, cherry petals rising around them, and the image holds on the academy banner snapping in the wind above the mountain.

overall_soundscape: Two sets of footsteps falling into the same rhythm, the jade characters chiming softly one final time, cherry petals whispering, and the academy banner snapping proudly in the morning wind.

non_diegetic_music: The warm string theme swells once to its full shape with koto and a soft taiko heartbeat, cutting clean on the held wide shot.
